pageSubtitle: Legal registration details and business information for Arseen Enterprises LLC.

usOffice.label: US Office Address
usOffice.note: This is the company's United States office address. It is not a public warehouse, retail location, or general product-return address.

businessDescription.heading: Business Description
businessDescription.para1: Arseen Enterprises LLC provides international product procurement, order fulfillment, inspection coordination, packaging, shipment coordination, and tracking support for businesses and individual consumers. Orders may be fulfilled through independent suppliers, logistics providers, and fulfillment partners in China and other approved sourcing locations.
businessDescription.para2: The company serves both business customers (B2B) and individual consumers (B2C). All orders receive a written quotation before payment.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.responseTime: Customer-support inquiries are normally answered within 1–2 business days.
